content: 1. Laboratory tests, such as measurements of sodium and potassium levels, may be conducted either before or after using this medication. It is important to attend all scheduled medical and laboratory appointments. 2. If you are unable to consume the entire prescribed solution and water as directed, contact your doctor immediately. 3. Store the unmixed container of this medication at room temperature, ensuring it is kept away from light and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. 4. Do not dispose of medications by flushing them down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. 5. This information was last updated in May 2024. 6. Sodium/potassium/magnesium sulfate solution is used to cleanse the intestines prior to certain bowel examination procedures, such as a colonoscopy. It acts as a laxative by drawing large amounts of water into the colon, resulting in watery bowel movements. 9. Before using this product, read the Medication Guide and Instructions for Use provided by your pharmacist. Follow any special dietary instructions given by your doctor. 10. Typically, you may have a light breakfast or consume only clear liquids on the day before your procedure. After breakfast, you should only drink clear liquids until after the procedure. Avoid milk, alcoholic beverages, and any food or drink that is red or purple in color. 11. Do not take any other oral medications within one hour of starting to drink the mixture. 12. Use this product as directed by your doctor, usually in two doses: one in the evening before the colonoscopy and the second dose the following morning. 13. To prepare the solution, pour the contents into the mixing container as instructed by the manufacturer. Add cool water, mix thoroughly, and drink the entire mixture. Afterward, drink two additional containers of water over the next hour. 14. Watery bowel movements typically begin approximately one hour after consuming the mixed solution. 15. Common side effects include very watery bowel movements, nausea, vomiting, bloating, and stomach or abdominal cramping. These effects are expected with this medication. 16. This medication has been prescribed because your doctor has determined that the benefits outweigh the risks of side effects. 17. This medication may cause excessive loss of fluids and salts, leading to dehydration or electrolyte imbalances. Monitor for symptoms of these conditions. 18. Serious allergic reactions to this medication are rare but possible. Seek immediate medical attention if you experience symptoms of a severe allergic reaction. 19. This is not an exhaustive list of potential side effects. In the United States, contact your doctor for medical advice about side effects. In Canada, consult your doctor for similar guidance. 20. Before taking this medication, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you have any allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could trigger allergic reactions or other issues. 21. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used when clearly necessary. It is not known whether this drug passes into breast milk. 22. Drug interactions may alter the effectiveness of your medications or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. 23. Maintain a list of all products you use, including prescription and non-prescription drugs and herbal supplements, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. 24. In the event of an overdose with serious symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222.
